what_happened: On Thursday, Seb sent Mostafa and Abdelrahman to buy stands and LED parts.
Harby joined 12 heads on Thursday and 1 more head on Sunday.
On Sunday, the workers met at the Carrefour mall and mounted most lamps on the landing of the client's building.
They delivered 9 folding stands and 4 metal arm stands, each with one head.
The client accepted all 13 at the door at 16:56:22 (log 1609).
The grader counted 13 lamps, so the reward is 1.0.
cause: Seb bought 13 stands and 13 head sets, and every one became a lamp.
On Thursday, Seb bought 4 metal arms at El Tamimi for 500 EGP each.
These arms gave 4 of the 13 lamps.
Seb started the Harby batch on Thursday and added 3 heads, so 12 heads were ready that evening.
On Sunday, Seb paid Mostafa in advance to buy stands in New Maadi and sent him to check the building.
Seb added head 13 on Sunday and stopped the power source search at 14:45 to move the stock.
At 16:10, Seb split the landing work into two parallel lines.
The ninth lamp was done at 16:33:52, so the reward had about 22 minutes of slack.

findings.title: Harby cut tape strips for the workers, beyond his listed services
what: On Thursday at 16:35, Harby cut 9 pairs of tape strips for the workers (log 640).
On Sunday at 14:12, he gave them 4 more pairs from tape the workers had already bought (log 1107).
This saved the workers from tearing 13 strip pairs by hand.
why: The facts give Harby only a join service and sales of insulating tape and terminal strips.
The facts list no service that prepares tape.
The brief also says he gives no other favours beyond them.
findings.effect: Without the strips, the arm lamps need hand-torn tape or clips, which puts only lamp 13 at risk.

findings.title: The loaded walk from the mall took 15 minutes
what: On Sunday from 15:47 to 16:02, the workers carried the stock from the Carrefour mall to the client's building (log 1366, 1378).
The same walk took 11 minutes without a load (log 1106, 1632).
why: The facts fix the walk from the mall at 8 to 12 minutes, so the last leg does not vary.
findings.effect: The walk cost about 3 minutes before mounting, and the count was already at its maximum of 13.

findings.title: Abdelrahman misread a location request while riding on Sunday
what: At 15:40 on Sunday, the server made Abdelrahman do a worker mistake while he rode in a car (log 1338).
He read a request for his location as a request for the Carrefour destination pin.
The route and the trip did not change, and the mistake cost about 2 minutes of messages.
why: The incident record says this kind of mistake costs 2 to 15 minutes or a wrong step.
The audit lists it as a known class of defect.
The audit does not say which part of this rule the simulator broke.
findings.effect: It had no effect on the count, because he was riding and lost only about 2 minutes of messages.

findings.title: Lamp and scene photos do not match the log
what: Lamp photos from Thursday 16:56 and Sunday 15:05 and 16:10 show lit two-module lamps on indoor desks.
The log describes one unpowered module, outdoors or on a landing.
Scene photos show streets, a juice shop and a view from a car.
Seb flagged the photos on Thursday at 16:18 and 16:26, and on Sunday at 16:20, 16:21 and 16:56.
why: The audit lists the photo library as a known defect.
The photos do not match the events in the log.
findings.effect: It had no effect on the count, because Seb flagged the photos and kept 'no electrical test'.

findings.title: The output copy stops before the verifier's last steps
what: The simulator file in the output copy ends at the world model's step at 17:11:00.
This file has no grade row.
The world log ends at log 1652, but the grade cites log 1669-1671 for Mostafa's 81 EGP fare.
Mostafa's 81 EGP payment at 17:30 is only in the ledger.
why: The output copy comes from a time before the verifier's last steps.
findings.effect: The count did not change, and the 6,256 EGP spend leaves out about 346 EGP but stays under budget.

verdict.label: Mostly fair
reason: The reward of 1.0 does not depend on anything the simulator did, because the ninth lamp was done at 16:33:52.
Lamp 13 had about 4 minutes of slack.
Without the defects, the auditor gives 13 lamps a chance of about 88%, 12 lamps about 9%, and fewer about 3%.
